the_pivot.en: Broadcom (NASDAQ: AVGO) exemplifies the ultimate high-operating-leverage conglomerate in global technology. By mastering two twin moats—Custom AI Accelerators (XPUs with Google TPU, Meta MTIA, and OpenAI) and Tomahawk 5/Jericho3-AI 51.2T networking silicon alongside the VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) private cloud virtualization stack—Broadcom commands industry-leading Gross Margins of 67%-70% and Operating Margins exceeding 40%-45%. The pivotal VMware acquisition integration in 2024 expanded revenues past $51B and pushed 2025-2026 revenue toward $64B-$75B while streamlining workforce to achieve record FTE productivity.
the_pivot.zh: 博通（Broadcom / AVGO）為全球極致高營運槓桿科技巨擘典範。憑藉雙輪驅動護城河——客製化 AI 晶片 (客製 XPU/ASIC 深度合作 Google TPU、Meta MTIA 與頂級雲端客戶) 及 Tomahawk 5 / Jericho3-AI 51.2Tbps 高階乙太網路晶片，搭配 VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) 私有雲虛擬化軟體堆疊，帶動毛利率長年穩居 67%～70%、營業利益率突破 40%～45%。2024 年完成 VMware 併購整合後營收衝破 515 億美元，並於 2025～2026 年快速挺進 640 億～750 億美元，展現驚人的人力精實與獲利飛輪。

productivity.en: Broadcom posts extraordinary human capital productivity indices, generating $1.94M - $2.21M USD in Revenue per FTE and $1.31M - $1.55M USD in Gross Profit per FTE, placing it among the highest per-employee value creators on Wall Street.
productivity.zh: 博通展現華爾街頂尖的人均產值表現，2025～2026 年每位員工創造高達 194 萬至 221 萬美元營收（約合新台幣 6,200 萬～7,000 萬元/人），人均毛利達 131 萬～155 萬美元，位居全球科技業最高人均產值第一梯隊。

value_vs_volume.en: Strategic pricing power in high-end AI networking switches and shift of VMware legacy perpetual licenses to subscription VCF annualized contract value (ACV) drive compounding high-margin recurring cash flows with minimal capex drag.
value_vs_volume.zh: 高階 AI 網路交換晶片的無可取代定價權，加上將 VMware 傳統永久授權成功轉型為高黏著度 VCF 訂閱年化合約價值（ACV），驅動充沛的重複性自由現金流，資本支出負擔極低。
